chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl narrated from Abū Ayyūb al-Khazzāz, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام, who said:

"Instruct our Shi'ah to perform the ziyārah of al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام, for indeed his ziyārah repels collapse, drowning, burning, and being devoured by beasts. And his ziyārah is obligatory upon the one who affirms al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام in the Imamate from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic."

key_terms.الْهَدْمَ: collapse or destruction falling upon a person
key_terms.بِالْإِمَامَةِ: the Imamate; the divinely appointed authority of the Imam
key_terms.بِزِيَارَةِ: with visitation; specifically the devotional ziyārah of Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام
key_terms.تَدْفَعُ: repels or wards off; indicating protection from harm
key_terms.شِيعَتَنَا: our Shi'ah; the followers and adherents addressed by the Imam
key_terms.مُفْتَرَضَةٌ: obligatory or prescribed as a duty

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the obligation and benefits of visiting Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام instructs the Shi'ah to visit Imam al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام and describes this ziyārah as a source of divine protection from major worldly harms. The hadith also presents the ziyārah of Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام as a binding duty for those who acknowledge his divinely granted Imamate.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3177 - Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal narrated from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:

"Direct our Shia to visit Imam Hussain ibn Ali (as) for his visitation protects from destruction, drowning, burning, and being devoured by beasts. His visitation is obligatory upon those who acknowledge Husayn (as) as an Imam from Allah (swt), the Mighty and Exalted."
